newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan currency policy unchanged -- MOF's Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: Japan currency policy unchanged -- MOF's Sakakibara.

text.p: Japan welcomes the developments that have taken place in foreign exchange markets since April 1995, and will continue to cooperate with other countries in the market, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, said on Monday.

"We welcome the developments (in foreign exchange markets) since April 1995, and we continue to cooperate in the foreign exchange markets (with other countries)," he told reporters, referring to the time last year when the yen hit a record high of 79.75 yen to the dollar.
"That's our position, and it hasn't changed. The foreign exchange policy (of Japan) is unchanged," he said.
